_about: All FallVision settings in one place. run_fall.py and live_fall.py read this file; nothing is set inside the code. Values marked 'validation' were chosen on validation videos only (results/fusion.md, Step 27). Values marked 'training' must match how the GRU was trained.

_notes.gru, threshold, score: validation (fuse.py); threshold 0.864 from the hard validation set was tested once and not kept (results/summary.md)
_notes.det_conf, join_v2: validation: low-confidence tracking and fall-aware joining gave no gain on the hard validation set (Step 27), so both stay off
_notes.small_px: Step 15: re-run at input 960 when the standing height (in a 1280-wide frame) is below this
_notes.model_fps, window_s, stride_s: training: the GRU sees 2-s windows of 30 skeletons at 15 per second
_notes.history_s: live mode: seconds of each person kept to measure their standing height and the floor level
_notes.rearm_s: live mode: after an alarm, the same person can raise a new alarm once their score has stayed below the threshold this long
